listen_address.description: IP address the service binds to for incoming entropy requests.

listen_port.description: Port number for the main entropy distribution service.

workers.description: Number of worker processes to handle client entropy requests.

max_queue_size.description: Maximum number of pending requests allowed in the queue.

entropy_source.description: Source of entropy: 'kernel' (kernel RNG), 'rdseed', 'rdrand' (Intel CPU instructions), or 'hwrng' (hardware RNG).

chunk_size.description: Size (in bytes) of each entropy chunk delivered to clients.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for secure delivery of entropy.

tls_cert_path.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (required if TLS is enabled).

tls_key_path.description: Path to the TLS private key file (required if TLS is enabled).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, or error.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for process management.

metrics_enabled.description: Enable metrics collection and HTTP endpoint.

metrics_listen_address.description: IP address for the metrics server (for local scraping only).

metrics_listen_port.description: Port number for the metrics HTTP endpoint.

upstream_sources.description: List of upstream entropy servers to pool entropy from (for redundancy).

name.description: Unique identifier for the upstream source.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the upstream entropy server.

port.description: Port of the upstream entropy server.

weight.description: Relative weight for load balancing between upstreams (higher = more requests).

allowed_networks.description: List of networks allowed to request entropy.

description.description: Human-readable description of the network purpose.

cidr.description: CIDR notation of the allowed client network.

rate_limiting_enabled.description: Enable per-client rate limiting to prevent abuse.

rate_limit_max_rps.description: Maximum requests per second per client IP.

rate_limit_burst_size.description: Burst size (max short-term spike) allowed per client.
